description:
Input schema for Seedance 2.5 video generation.

Three task categories (auto-detected from parameters):
- First frame / First & last frame: set image (and optionally end_image)
- Multi-reference: set reference_images / reference_videos / reference_audios
- Text-to-video: provide prompt only

The API determines the specific task type (Video Editing, Video Extension,
or Video Reference) automatically. For Video Editing tasks, duration is
forced to -1. For First & Last Frame, Video Editing, or Video Extension
tasks, ratio must be 'adaptive'.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video content. Supports English, Japanese, Indonesian, Spanish, and Portuguese.
examples: A cat stretches lazily on a sunlit windowsill, yawning as golden afternoon light filters through sheer curtains.
prompt.title: Prompt

image.description: First-frame image for image-to-video generation. Mutually exclusive with reference inputs.
image.title: Image

end_image.description: Last-frame image for first+last frame video generation. Requires image to be set as the first frame. Ratio must be 'adaptive'.
end_image.title: End Image

reference_images.description: Reference images for multimodal generation (up to 9). Use prompt to describe how to use each, e.g. 'Image 1', 'Image 2'. Mutually exclusive with image/end_image.
reference_images.title: Reference Images

reference_videos.description: Reference videos for multimodal generation (up to 3). Max 15s each, total max 15s. Formats: mp4/mov (MOV recommended for best quality). Mutually exclusive with image/end_image.
reference_videos.title: Reference Videos

reference_audios.description: Reference audios for multimodal generation (up to 3). Max 15s each, total max 15s. Formats: wav/mp3. Requires at least one image or video.
reference_audios.title: Reference Audios

resolution.description: Video resolution. 4k for ultra-high quality (10-bit color, ~2x cost of 1080p), 1080p for high quality, 720p for balanced, 480p for fastest.

ratio.description: Aspect ratio. Must be 'adaptive' for first+last frame, video editing, and video extension tasks. 'adaptive' auto-selects based on input content.

duration.description: Duration in seconds (4-30). Set to -1 for Video Editing tasks (auto-determined by API).
duration.title: Duration

output_format.description: Output video format. MOV provides higher quality; recommended when using video references.

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate synchronized audio with the video.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

watermark.description: Whether to add watermark to the output video.
watermark.title: Watermark

safety_identifier.description: Unique identifier of end user for platform safety policy. Must be fixed and unique per user, max 64 chars. Recommended: hash of username, user ID, or email.
safety_identifier.title: Safety Identifier

title: AppInput
